findings.description: The collision check no longer removes names reserved by a parameter's secondary options, allowing the generated help option to override a declared flag.
findings.rationale: For a command with a boolean option `--feature/--no-feature` and `help_option_names=["--help", "--no-feature"]`, `--no-feature` is stored in `param.secondary_opts`. The new loop only removes `param.opts`, so the generated help option also claims `--no-feature`. Invoking that flag then displays help instead of disabling the feature.
